title: Square-root delocalization of binary Hayes conductor layers
statement: Let ell >= 200, let n be 2 ell + 1 or 2 ell + 2, put D_e=N_n(e)-2^(n-ell), and let D_[j]=P_j D-P_(j-1)D be its exact-conductor martingale layer. For every 4<=j<=ell and every class e, |D_[j](e)|^2 is at most 4 (j-1)^2 2^(j-1+n-2ell).

provenance.source: Axeyum gf2-lemire lane; exact conductor martingale reduction and endpoint implication

notes: This is the open SUP-L statement, not a promoted finite computation. The individual character Weil bound proves the same inequality for j<=3, so the machine-visible obligation begins at j=4. Exact bounded rows through ell=20 require squared constant at most four, but those rows are falsification controls only. The native implication derives M_4 <= 2500 ell^4 2^(3ell) and checks the proper-power-aware finite handoff at degrees 401 and 402. A more general C ell^a loss is also sufficient for fixed C,a. No Autogenesis operation is registered because no checker establishes the quantified estimate.
